title: Run pane follows the newest running run, with a 1 s ledger refresh while a run is visible

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner 2026-10-25, from a screenshot of the Overview with a run pane open (S28's relay): when the opened run finishes the pane does not update; the owner has to esc and select the next running item to see the status of its steps. The pane is pinned to the run id it was opened on (internal/tui/pane.go:15-29, paneRow) and only changes with a snapshot (every 5 s for the visible project). Owner decisions: (1) when the run in the pane finishes the pane automatically switches to the newest running run (no toggle); (2) a 1 s ledger refresh while a pane or Running row is visible. Not addressed by the run-card, fold or S99 slices.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/pane.go` (runPane, paneRow, openPane) and `model.go`: on each snapshot, when the pane's run is no longer running and a newer running run exists, re-point the pane to it (same project first, then the newest across projects is NOT included: same project only); keep the offset reset and the answer-input state sane; when no running run exists, stay on the ended run showing its final state (outcome, frozen bar).
- `internal/daemon/` (poll or snapshot focus loop; `internal/poll/poll.go:4`): a 1 s ledger (relay-run list) refresh for the visible project only while a run is live; other projects stay at 30 s; the cadence returns to 5 s when nothing runs.
- `internal/tui/view.go` and `relayboard.go`: a one-line notice in the pane header when it switched ("switched to S28; S27 ended pass") that fades after the next refresh.
- Tests beside each, `testdata/golden/pane-*.txt`, `docs/dashboard.md` (pane section) and `docs/design.md` (refresh policy).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestPaneSwitchesToTheNewestRunningRunWhenItsRunEnds: the pane was opened on run A; A ends and run B (same project) is running; the next snapshot re-points the pane to B and shows the switch notice.
- TestPaneStaysOnTheEndedRunWhenNothingElseRuns: shows the final state, frozen bar, no switch.
- TestPaneDoesNotSwitchWhileTheOwnerIsTypingAnAnswer: a paused question pane with text in the input does not re-point (the answer is for that run).
- TestPaneSwitchResetsScrollOffset.
- TestLedgerRefreshIsOneSecondForTheVisibleProjectWhileARunIsLive and returns to 5 s and 30 s otherwise (injected clock).
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first (injected clock). 2. The re-point rule in the snapshot handler. 3. The faster refresh in the daemon/poll loop, only for the visible project with a live run. 4. The switch notice. 5. Docs and goldens. UI slice: UI pass (r14). Decided 2026-10-25 (owner): always auto-switch to the newest running run; 1 s refresh while visible.
Open for the preflight to settle with the owner: whether the switch may cross projects (recommend same project only), and what happens to an open answer input (recommend: never switch a pane whose answer input has text).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui ./internal/daemon ./internal/poll
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] With a pane open on a running relay, the owner lets it finish and sees the pane move on to the next running run within a couple of seconds.
